# Forbidden AI

> A small software studio in India — software, consulting, and AI.

## About

Forbidden AI builds production software, AI integrations, and internal tools
for companies worldwide. We refuse hype, unsafe shortcuts, and theatre.

## Tools

- [ERD Forge](https://forbiddenai.in/tools/erd-forge): Free, local-first ERD modeling tool. Design database schemas visually, import SQL DDL from PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite, analyze query lineage. No account. No server. Data stays in your browser. Open source. Built by Forbidden AI.
